newsitem.title: JAPAN: AWAJI FERRY TO BE PUT ON SURVEILLANCE POST - OSE. [CORRECTED 10:28 GMT]
newsitem.headline: AWAJI FERRY TO BE PUT ON SURVEILLANCE POST - OSE. [CORRECTED 10:28 GMT]

text.p: The Osaka Securities Exchange said on Monday that shares of Awaji Ferry Boat Co Ltd would be put on the surveillance post.
(Corrects to show announcement was made by Osaka Securities Exchange, not by the Tokyo Stock Exchange).
A stock is put on the surveillance post when it is deemed to be no longer able to meet qualifications for listing.
The company said earlier that it would terminate its mainstay vehicle and passenger shipping operations on April 5, 1998.
Sales from the shipping business amounted to 8.8 billion yen in the last business year to March, accounting for more than 90 percent of total sales of 9.5 billion yen.
